title: TemplateFillFacts
description: The in-place firm-template fill's decision record (P17/C8, B75§3c) — the writeback-facts pattern for the firm_default lane, in its own vocabulary: a fill records SECTIONS replaced (guidance stripped, placeholder removed), not cells written. Every section the template carries appears exactly once — filled, honestly left carrying its guidance, or refused with the reason — so 'what still needs a human?' is answerable by looking (remaining_guidance is v1's reporter made contract). The template at config/ is never mutated; output_file is the copy under exports/submission/.

plan_sha256.description: The frozen plan whose sections fed the fill — prose comes only from what it names.

draft_sha256.description: The exact envelope whose section prose landed in the template.

confirmed_by.description: The human who confirmed the previewed fill (S7) — it never runs unconfirmed.

template_file.description: The firm template the copy was made FROM (config/templates/…).

template_sha256.description: Must equal the reference_sha256 the path_b_outline checkpoint recorded — the fill only touches the EXACT template the plan was built against (the digest-bound-source rule, B74§3b).

output_file.description: The filled copy under exports/submission/ — for firm_default pursuits this IS the to-the-buyer document (B75§1d: it replaces the generated response.docx).

section_id.description: The plan section whose prose fed (or should have fed) this template section.

slot_id.description: The template slot (s-hNN…) the section bound through based_on.

docx_anchor.description: The template heading, verbatim — placement is re-derived by reparse (guidance_box_map), never persisted.

decision.description: filled = section prose REPLACED the guidance box and the placeholder table was removed (replacement-not-insertion); kept_guidance = no drafted prose for this section, so its guidance survives IDENTICAL — the honest outcome, reported in remaining_guidance; fill_by_hand = the shape has no automated fill (grids, case blocks, the metadata table, inline bracketed paragraphs — B75§1e) and a human finishes it; refused_unnamed = the frozen plan names no section for this template anchor.

paragraphs.description: filled: how many delivered paragraphs replaced the guidance box.

placeholder_removed.description: filled: the '[ Replace with … ]' placeholder table was deleted too — the v1 gap fixed (v1 shipped documents still carrying them).

remaining_guidance.description: The guidance texts still in the output — the sections a human still owns (v1's remaining_guidance reporter, now on the record). Includes fill_by_hand shapes.
